pick.name: Built-in auto memory + CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md
pick.what: Claude-written MEMORY.md + topic files per repo (shared across worktrees), plus your CLAUDE.md rules
pick.why: First-party, no daemon, plain markdown, loaded every session (first 200 lines/25KB)

alts.name: claude-mem (thedotmack)
alts.what: Hook-captured observations, SQLite + Chroma semantic search over all past sessions
alts.why: Adds searchable session history that auto memory lacks
alts.free_limits: local free; hosted observer 30-day trial; cmem.ai cloud sync paid
alts.windows_fit: native (needs Node 20, Bun, uv; worker HTTP API)

alts.name: Basic Memory
alts.what: Markdown knowledge graph via MCP, readable in Obsidian
alts.why: Best if you want a human-curated notes vault the agent also uses

candidates.name: claude-mem
candidates.verdict: keep as add-on only if you actually search past sessions; heavy (Bun+uv+Chroma+local HTTP worker)

candidates.name: Basic Memory
candidates.verdict: AGPL, MCP must be called explicitly

decision: Auto memory is first-party, zero-maintenance and already does the core job. claude-mem is the best add-on for cross-session search but costs a background worker, hooks on every prompt and a cloud sign-in prompt; keep it with a local provider (CLAUDE_MEM_ONLINE_OPTIN=false) or remove it if you don't use mem-search weekly.
details: If you install claude-mem, don't also install its Cowork variant in Claude Code; the skills duplicate.

verify.note: Doc confirms auto memory per repo, shared across worktrees, loaded every session (first 200 lines or 25KB); AGENTS.md supported.
